name: Weighted Prior Based Reconstruction
aliases: Tomographic Reconstruction to Detect New Structures
definition: A tomographic reconstruction method that uses spatially varying weights to moderate the local influence of prior templates, allowing for the detection and accurate reconstruction of new structures in longitudinal scans while suppressing prior dominance in unchanged regions.
summary: Weighted Prior Based Reconstruction is a tomographic method using spatially varying weights to moderate prior template influence, enabling detection of new structures while suppressing prior dominance in unchanged regions.
